description: This file defines the RawFilter class in the Twig templating engine, specifically for handling the 'raw' filter in Twig templates. It extends the FilterExpression class and is responsible for compiling the raw filter expression without escaping the content.

classes.name: RawFilter
classes.description: A class representing the 'raw' filter expression in Twig templates, extending FilterExpression to handle rendering logic specific to the raw filter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for RawFilter, which initializes the filter with a node and optional filter parameters, issuing a deprecation warning if the node is not an instance of AbstractExpression.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the raw filter expression by delegating to the Subcompile method of the compiler for the contained node.
